name: winkies fruit cake

ARTIFICIAL FLAVOUR (VANILLA), EDIBLE COMMON SALT, PRESERVATIVES (INS 282, INS 200, INS 211), ACIDITY REGULATOR (INS 260), EMULSIFIER (INS 471), STABILIZER (INS 412 AND INS 415 NATURE IDENTICAL AND NATURAL FLAVOUR (ORANGE AND LEMON).
